limits: The browser matrix samples 20 routes; all 4225 molecule routes are separately rendered by data tests, not visually inspected one by one.
The SVG framing and sanitization test uses a synthetic fixture, not a newly invented pharmacological structure.
External ChEMBL, RCSB and Mol* availability is not certified by the offline-capable browser test.
This is a software and presentation audit, not a clinical validation of every pharmacological statement.
The catalog is not 4225 complete monographs; missing scientific information remains explicitly identified.
